_comments._about: Copy this file to apply/user/profile.json and fill it in. Factual fields only. The agent types these values into ATS forms. Leave any field empty to have the agent skip it and list it as pending.
_comments.name: Full name as it appears on your resume. Greenhouse splits it on the last space into first and last name.
_comments.phone: Phone number with country code, for example +1 555 555 5555.
_comments.location: Current city and state or country, for example Boston, MA. Used for location typeahead fields.
_comments.school: Current or most recent school, exactly as ATS school dropdowns list it.
_comments.degree: Degree type, for example Bachelor of Science.
_comments.major: Field of study, for example Computer Science.
_comments.grade_level: Current year, for example Junior or Rising Senior.
_comments.gpa: GPA as a string, for example 3.8. Leave empty to never volunteer it.
_comments.grad_date: Expected graduation, for example May 2028. ATS forms usually want month and year.
_comments.work_authorization: Answer to 'Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?'. Use Yes or No.
_comments.requires_sponsorship: Answer to 'Will you now or in the future require sponsorship?'. Use Yes or No.
_comments.veteran_status: EEO field. Optional. Use the ATS wording or 'decline' to select the decline-to-answer option.
_comments.disability_status: EEO field. Optional. Use the ATS wording or 'decline'.
_comments.gender: EEO field. Optional. Use the ATS wording or 'decline'.
_comments.race_ethnicity: EEO field. Optional. Use the ATS wording or 'decline'.
_comments.custom: Free key/value map for anything else the agent may answer from, for example clearance level or spoken languages. Keys are your own labels. The agent only uses these when a screener clearly asks for one.
